name: beyond_get_definitions
description: Discover supported technologies with beyond_get_definitions(definition_names=["design_navigation_guide"]). React frontend uses react_application. Read only the selected model_design_guide:<type> and processor_design_guide:<type>. Verify the current runtime catalog before claiming a technology is unsupported. Get MCP tool/schema definitions. Without definition_names, returns a compact index. With tool names such as beyond_create_entities, returns tool schemas. With schema names such as entity_info_create, returns JSON schema definitions. Query beyond_get_definitions(definition_names=["processor_storage_types"]) for the exhaustive global processor ID/title catalog with allowed model types. A model acceptable_processors list is only its allowed subset, not the global catalog. Guide delivery is session-scoped by guide_id and guide_revision: first delivery includes delivery=full and content, subsequent responses use delivery=reference without content. MUST read and follow full content. A paged guide counts as delivered only after every page is returned. If context was lost, use the details call (beyond_get_definitions, mode=full, include_examples=true) to retrieve the full guide again. A new session, changed revision or expired delivery cache resends content. Delivery records do not prove the AI read it. Never retry model creation merely to recover expired pages; re-read the model.

definition_names.description: Tool names or JSON schema definition names to retrieve

mode.description: input_schema returns compact tool input/output schemas. full returns full matching tool and JSON schema definitions.

output_contract_note: No outputSchema is declared by the inspected public source definition. Consult live help and actual results; do not infer a missing output contract.
